s.how: Cut 200g cheddar into 20 even cubes. Thread each onto a toothpick with a fold of salami from 100g and a cherry tomato from a 250g punnet. Lay them out in two neat rows of exactly ten.

s.note: Caesars Palace after the card counting
s.how: Poach 500g green prawns in salted water for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water and peel. Mix 125ml tomato sauce with 1 tbsp horseradish and lemon juice. Pile on crushed ice with the sauce and lemon wedges, buffet style.

m.note: maple syrup on the table before the pancakes
m.how: Put the maple syrup on the table before anything else. Whisk 300g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 tbsp sugar, 500ml buttermilk and 2 eggs and rest 15 minutes. Cook in butter until bubbles set and stack high.

w.n: Fresh strawberry jelly with vanilla cream
w.note: Raymond's routine, the same dessert done the same way
w.how: Blend 500g hulled strawberries with 100g caster sugar and the juice of 1 lemon, then strain. Soak 4 gelatine leaves in cold water for 5 minutes, squeeze and dissolve in 150ml of the purée warmed in a pan. Stir into the rest of the purée and pour into 4 glasses over a few sliced strawberries. Chill 4 hours. Whip 200ml cream with 1 tsp vanilla paste and 1 tbsp icing sugar, spoon on and crumble 2 shortbread fingers over.

d.note: the maple syrup goes on the table before the pancakes
d.how: Put 8 mint leaves, 15ml maple syrup and 20ml lemon juice in a shaker for each drink and press gently with a muddler. Add 50ml bourbon and a scoop of ice and shake hard for 10 seconds. Strain into 4 rocks glasses packed with crushed ice. Garnish with a mint sprig and a thin apple slice. Totals are 200ml bourbon, 60ml maple syrup and 80ml lemon juice.
